results.name: Engine composes a transient economy ECS without changing the story shape
Facade XP settlement applies actor level, bond and character points once
Chapter command settles its complete reward once and leaves journaling outside ECS
Adventure return uses one reward settlement including village prestige
Growth research authorizes first and settles research plus XP before unlocking
Prestige purchases spend only current prestige and preserve earned prestige
Market sale settles cash and both XP rewards exactly once
Story roundtrip reconstructs settlement services and resumes deterministic rewards
